subject.title: [Feature]: Deeplink/contentIntent support in system.notify for Android nodes

question: Should Android `system.notify` support notification tap deeplinks, and if so must taps be restricted to OpenClaw-owned destinations or the same explicit allowlist policy as the Android URL-launch request?
rationale: A review worker can prove the current behavior is missing, but cannot safely choose a native Android app-launch/security boundary for gateway-provided notification params.

options.title: Define a narrow safe tap policy
options.body: Approve `system.notify` tap support only after specifying allowed targets, whether it shares the Android URL-launch allowlist, and the expected structured errors/tests.

options.title: Fold this into the URL-launch design
options.body: Treat notification taps as a consumer of the broader Android allowlisted URL/deeplink command and keep this issue as notification-specific acceptance criteria.

options.title: Keep `system.notify` informational
options.body: Reject external deeplink taps and allow only an OpenClaw app launch or no tap action for Android system notifications.

recommendation.title: Define a narrow safe tap policy
recommendation.body: Approve `system.notify` tap support only after specifying allowed targets, whether it shares the Android URL-launch allowlist, and the expected structured errors/tests.

likelyOwner.reason: This person is currently assigned to the issue and has adjacent Android notification tap history, making them the best available owner for the security/product decision.
